programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Saudi Arabia is one of the few absolute monarchies in the world where Muslim Sharia law still applies.Raha Moharrak was born there - she had enough courage and determination to break the prevailing patterns, thanks to which she was able to fulfill her dreams and conquer the Crown of the Earth, the highest peaks of seven continents.The heroine of the episode achieved this as the first woman from Saudi Arabia.In a country where her gender gained voting rights only in 2011, and in 2018 they were allowed to drive a car or travel abroad without the consent of a male guardian.The biggest problem for Raha was getting her father's consent to participate in the Kilimanjaro expedition, because according to Sharia law, a daughter must obey her parent, and he was against her idea, as was traditional society.However, the girl did not give up.When she conquered Mount Everest, she became a national media star.She continues to inspire other women.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Malawi is a small East African country.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Theresa Kachindamoto, who lives and works in the Dedza district.She is called the Terminator by the inhabitants of the country.She was born into a tribal royal family, the youngest of thirteen siblings.When her eldest brother died, the rest of her siblings elected her as the leader of the almost million-strong community.Never before has a woman performed such an important function.Thanks to her rule, Theresa gained fame and notoriety.During the dozen or so years she was in power, she opposed the customs of the time, annulling over five thousand marriages of underage girls.However, the activities of the heroine of the episode are appreciated not only in her country.At the White House, she received the Local Community Leader award from Michelle Obama and Hillary Clinton.Thanks to Chief Kachindamoto, thousands of underage women were able to return to school - previously 40% of them were married off before they turned 18.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In Georgia, there is a clear division into female and male roles.Women have to take care of the house and give birth to children, while men work.In the Caucasus, family is the most valuable, infertility is a taboo topic.Mariam Kukunashvili helps couples, including homosexual ones, who want to have children but are struggling with difficulties.She created a network of clinics, and today she is one of the most influential and richest women in the country.She was inspired by her own story - to become a mother, she underwent many years of treatment, struggled with difficult experiences, and finally used the help of surrogates.Patients can benefit from in vitro treatment, the services of surrogate mothers or an egg bank.Similar practices are a controversial topic in Georgia, especially among women.Mariam Kukunashvili breaks stereotypes in the context of traditional society.Its activities have expanded to other parts of the world, including:Ukraine, South Africa, Mexico and Kenya.Thanks to this, 7,000 children from 70 countries have already been born.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Kenya, located in East Africa, is inhabited by 55 million people, over 40 different tribes who speak almost 70 languages ​​in total.Although there is a real mosaic of cultures and beliefs there, not everyone is accepted, and being different can even cost your life.Martyna Wojciechowska visits this republic to meet Darlan.She claims to be the first outed intersex person in her country.Today, he is popular, sings, records music videos, designs clothes, and preaches tolerance.However, this was not always the case.A child born with sexual organs different from those typical of a boy or girl may be considered a curse on the community and killed.Darlan's childhood was marked by humiliation, sarcastic remarks, but also attacks and loneliness.Currently he is fighting for "others".The Darlan Rukih Church is one of the 4,000 officially registered in Kenya and has half a million believers.He cares for all those who are rejected.
